text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"A PK shootout? With Kawakami-chan? ...I 
don't think I'd be much of a match for 
her~. Why not ask someone else? Sorry 
about that..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Grrr...! I have been turned down yet 
again~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, Duramente-san! Please, I beg of 
you, engage in a penalty shootout duel 
with me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Episode 24 of ‘Mu-Mu-Muscle! PuriFy’ 
...‘Fierce Battle! Sparkling Tears Turn 
into Strength’! It's such a tearjerker 
where she has a penalty shootout against 
the prince's best friend!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just like PriFie! I want to have an 
all-out penalty shootout and become a 
splendid princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
P-Please, I beg of you~! You are so 
wonderfully gifted at sports, 
Duramente-san, so we truly need your help!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. If it's a sporting 
challenge, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to give it my all~! Let's have a 
fair and square match, Duramente-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes upon this! Princess... 
SHOOOOOT!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAAAANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...The ball popped?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh! I-I've gone and done it again...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Again?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The other day, while we were playing 
basketball... I ended up shattering the 
hoop with a slam dunk.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Lately, whenever I invite people to play 
sports ...everyone turns me down.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is why I am so pleased to have you 
join me, Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Even when pushed to the brink, seeing 
PreFie give it their all in the PK 
showdown... My heart trembled with 
emotion."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just like PriFie! I shall never give up 
until I reach the goal... and step closer 
to my ideal princess!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
............ To come closer... to my 
ideal...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Duramente-san has been training 
non-stop, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's to prove she's the strongest, right? 
Talk about insanely high standards~. It 
feels like she's on a totally different 
level from us.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...... I'll be stepping away for a moment. 
Wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking past the soccer field, I 
spotted Duramente trying to hand a ball 
over to Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Since this ball is made for Umamusume, it 
should be fine even if you kick it with 
all your might. ...I also brought along 
heavy-duty keeper gloves.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for hesitation. For the 
sake of your own ideals... throw 
everything you have at me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san...! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Behold a blow befitting a princess— Take 
thiiiiiiisssss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A ferocious shot has been fired! Kicking 
up a shockwave, the ball flies straight 
toward Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Haa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMACKKKK!! Whirrrrr... rrr... fsshhhh...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Splendid~~~!! To catch my full power 
head-on like that!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Your earnest feelings, burning with ideals 
...I have received them.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Th-Th-Those words...! They're identical 
to what the Prince's best friend said to 
PriFie~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...? At any rate, I'm glad you were able 
to give it your all.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we could help her out!
Glad I could be there for her!
Duramente is so kind, isn't she

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...? At any rate, I'm glad you were able 
to give it your all.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we could help her out!
Glad I could be there for her!
Duramente is so kind, isn't she

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ...Indeed. I am glad that 
nobility, blazing a trail for the sake of 
an ideal, was not lost.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
S-So cool...! Truly, you're just like a 
prince's closest companion...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, won't you watch Prifight 
with me next time!? I'm sure it'll get 
your hype through the roof~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I will consider it. Like you, I 
might learn how to fulfill my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, so you were watching. However... 
me, gentle?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is it! Since you've gone through so 
much trouble to keep me company in my 
showdowns!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I would be delighted to lend you my aid! 
If you don't mind, please allow me to join 
you for training sometime!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. So that we may both move 
toward our goals."
